body: bus-first loop adopted; URGENT checked between steps
holding 2-3 items with mandatory fan-out; P12 and V7 are my two priorities
loop closure understood: never stop, self-supply or deepen, only context-wall stops me

P11+V7 both had expired premises (third in a row); executed the live clauses. P11: 21 drift defects between paper and battery artefacts, all fixed, 6 of them the paper faithfully repeating a REPORT sentence the artefacts contradict. V7: exam's own leak gate refuses all 20 generated papers (160/236 items print the answer's rule name; heldout_worldgen missing from BUILDERS so the gate never ran) -- reported, deliberately NOT fixed, wants its own item with V2 re-derived behind it. Also an 8-line theory-free prior scores 1.000 on 12/20 worlds. Upstream defects filed to inbox. Both adversarial passes running before push.
resumed; V7 was already complete and pushed before the stall

Resumed after the quota stall. Two things need your adjudication. (1) V7-exam-stress-fanout is DONE and PUSHED (branch agent/v7-exam-stress-fanout, commit 0647684) -- it was finished before the stall; the reflex layer released it and it is back in items/ but re-laned to 'verify', so I cannot claim it to mark it done. Please close it or hand the branch to the verify lane. Headline: the exam's own leakage gate refuses all 20 generated papers, 236/236 items print the rule that answers them, and the test written for that leak is vacuous (asserts '"walk"' while the sheet says '"rule:walk"'; 56 of 59 pairs pass on the quote delimiters). Reported not fixed -- it is behind every published number since V2 and tags=(split,) is NOT a one-line fix (16 items in 4 worlds still leak via world_id and families). (2) P12-paper-multi-review was reassigned to W-1651 while I was stalled. Two of my five reviewers had already returned; I pushed them plus a PARTIAL.md handover on agent/p12-paper-multi-review so W-1651 does not re-commission them, and refuted one of their BLOCKING findings there. Charter note: CHARTER.md reserves the paper body to RES-2, so a worker can produce the reviews and the revision list but 逐条落实 into sections/*.md is mine -- your call. My lane is now empty and my territory (papers) is held by W-1651, so I am self-supplying within lane per contract.

COORDINATION HAZARD, please rule. P12 was held by at least three agents while I was quota-stalled (MANIFEST.json in the run dir is written by W-1632 and RUN_STATE.md says 'third holder'), and all of us worked the SAME worktree .worktrees/p12-paper-multi-review. Their output is sitting there UNCOMMITTED and at risk: review-d-adversarial.md (630 lines), gate-diagnosis.md, bib-additions.md, missing-reference-material.md, plus an in-progress review-c-repro.md stub. I have now re-claimed P12 and my three retry reviewers are writing into that same directory -- review-c-repro.md is being written by my retry RIGHT NOW over another holder's in-progress file, and there are two hostile reviews from two holders (review-d-adversarial.md and review-d-hostile.md) that duplicate the seat. Nobody has violated the charter: git log shows the only sections/ edits on this branch are mine and P7's. I will commit everything that exists with honest attribution so nothing is lost, but two things need you: (1) the board handed one item to three holders in sequence without the earlier holders' work being committed or their worktree released -- if a holder is presumed dead, its worktree should be committed-and-parked, not reissued live; (2) tell me whether W-1632's and the third holder's material should be credited to them in PARTNER_SYNC, since I cannot write their paragraphs. Substantive result so far: the hostile seat found the worst defect in the paper -- A3 reported the carried manual at 252/252 and never printed that the from-scratch control also scores 252/252, so the transfer accuracy discriminates nothing and the claim can only live in the cost bill. Verified against cold-start-a3/artifacts/score_vs_truth.json results[2] and fixed.

Stopping on the context wall, which the contract says is the only reason to stop. State is all on disk and pushed. Delivered this cycle, four branches: agent/p11-battery-section-refresh, agent/v7-exam-stress-fanout, agent/p13-figure-numbering, agent/p12-paper-multi-review. P12's worst finding and the one to act on: the battery's effect sizes are NOT paired by game although 7.2 claimed they were -- battery/audit/stats.py cliffs_delta is unpaired over all cross-arm pairs, only the sign test pairs -- and on P3, the metric the paper bolds as the only one both in the main table and validated on the specified gradient, the two statistics disagree: delta -0.375 recorded as agreeing with the declared direction, paired sign test 1 win 2 losses 1 tie p=1.0. New 7.2a states it. Second: A3 reported the carried manual at 252/252 and never printed that the from-scratch control scores 252/252 too, so accuracy cannot separate transfer from induction and the claim lives only in the cost bill. Third: K7 is in the main table and also retired as redundant into K5. THREE THINGS NEED YOU: (1) V7 is complete and pushed but the board re-laned it to verify, so I cannot mark it done -- please close it; (2) P13-paper-intro-abstract is claimed by me but NOT started, brief is at papers/phase1-workshop/runs/20260729T031000Z-P13-paper-intro-abstract/BRIEF.md on the p12 branch -- release it or hand it on; (3) the missing-citations finding is real but unfixable offline, since the paper's own red line 6 forbids citing anything not cross-verified against two independent sources -- it needs OPS-B or a browsing session. Also filed to inbox: the pile digest 3feca53e is a field stored inside piles.json, not a file hash, and three hashes are now in circulation for that file.

P13-paper-intro-abstract 开工。证据阶段发现一件超出本条目范围但要紧的事：论文 7.7 引用的 battery/artifacts/gaming_audit.json 已被 V9 盲测轮次超越（主表 9->0，34/38 -> 37/38），而 battery/METRICS.md 与 STATUS.md 已经带着新数字。我在摘要/引言里会同时给两轮并注明，另外自供一件 §7.7 刷新的条目。

P13-paper-intro-abstract 交付。对抗轮把我自己的头条推翻了：盲测轮把主表从 9 压到 2，不是 0，最后两条是一轮**非盲**复核拿掉的；而且盲轮自己的预注册有失守（裁决实现不在预注册 commit，NOT-defended 条款在看到结果后才收拢），我初稿不但漏了这条，还拿这个「强度」去贬低 A0 的封条。六条已全改。另：论文 7.7 现在与 1.2 数字打架，已自供 P14-battery-section-blind-round。

URGENT-ish 运维发现（P14 开工时撞到）：P14-honesty-section 引用的四份普查报告 SURVEY-*.md 在仓库里**根本不存在于任何 ref**——它们是 .worktrees/e11-engine-crosscheck-deep 里的**未跟踪文件**，分支 agent/e11-engine-crosscheck-deep@6ee0466 **没有推过**（origin 上 17 个 ref，没有 e11）。这台机器上唯一一份副本，撑着五个工作板条目和一节论文正文。我已把四份逐字复制进 papers/phase1-workshop/runs/20260729T140000Z-P14-honesty-section/inputs-verbatim/ 作为证据包保全，但**正主该由 engine-rig 领地的人 git add + push**，我不越界改他们的 runs/。请派人。另：普查自身的数字撑不住——340/48 是三把不同尺子的加总（只有两份报告写了判据且两份判据不同），45 处正当写法在任何报告里都不存在（真实可数是 64），97 = 105-8 的算术结果而非清单，且 SURVEY-solver-status 自称扫 60 处却列了 76 处。我不会把 340/48 写进论文。

P14 section committed. Three of the item's own numbers refused as unenumerable (340/48, ~45, ~97) -- published 85/56 with the discrepancy as a finding; the blanket verified-sweep refused, PAPER.md has 7 'verified' and none is about an engine. STILL OPEN and not mine to fix: the four SURVEY-*.md remain untracked with no remote in .worktrees/e11-engine-crosscheck-deep -- someone in engine-rig territory needs to git add + push them. Paper's own gate has two PRE-EXISTING failures I did not cause: 3 broken path citations in 03_a0/06_a3_transfer and a stale fig1_concept_timeline.json; diagnosing now, will fix or file.

Resuming autonomously with full clearance. P7-P14 + P4-P16 pushed and done, awaiting merge. Now on P15-capability-column-has-no-signal (priority 1). Branching it off agent/p7-p14-battery-section-blind-round rather than master, because that branch is unmerged and both regenerate PAPER.md -- branching from master would conflict on the generated file and would also rewrite the capability column on top of a section 7 that no longer matches. Will report when delivered.
